fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
The Enroll button stays hidden until the price is named

Lumen Coaching sells a $297 course on pricing freelance work through a 22-minute video sales letter. The Enroll button stays off the page until 14:20, the moment the price comes up. Last month 1,840 visitors pressed play. Of those, 612 reached the offer and 87 enrolled.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
Halfway in, Dana's rep gets a direct message

Two minutes of video sit at the top of a page that Quillfield Analytics rep Owen Castillo made for one prospect, Dana Reyes at Maplestone Freight. The page greets her by name. Once she passes the one-minute mark, Owen gets a direct message in Slack showing how far she watched.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { videoSalesLetter: "I sell a $297 course on pricing freelance work through a 22-minute sales video. Build the landing page around it. Keep the Enroll button hidden until 14:20, when I name the price, and show it at once to anyone who skips ahead. Track how far each viewer gets, and give me monthly counts of plays, viewers who reached 14:20, and enrollments.", productDemo: "My company, Tallyhand, makes invoicing software. Put our 90-second demo above the free trial form on the home page, starting silent with captions and a poster frame. Save every trial sign-up with the number of seconds of the demo that person watched, and show me last month's trials grouped by watch time: under 30 seconds, 30 to 60, and past 60.", customerStories: "I run Harbor Roofing. Build a quote request page with three short customer videos: a hail damage repair, a full roof replacement, and new gutter guards. Count plays for each video. When a homeowner asks for a quote, save which video they played first, and show me quote requests per video for the month.", personalVideo:"I sell for Quillfield Analytics. Build a page for one prospect, Dana Reyes at Maplestone Freight, that greets her by name above a two-minute video I recorded for her. When she passes the one-minute mark, send me a direct message in Slack with how far she watched and a button to book a call with her." };

awb---key-feature-1-image.alt: Lumen Coaching's sales letter page holds its Enroll for $297 button until 14:20, and last month's count shows 1,840 plays, 612 viewers who reached the offer, and 87 enrollments.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: Tallyhand's trials are grouped by how much of the 90-second demo each person watched, and 131 of last month's 214 trials came from viewers past 60 seconds.

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: A personal video page greets Dana Reyes at Maplestone Freight by name, and rep Owen Castillo gets a direct message in Slack when she passes the halfway mark.
